title: Global search lists an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A.
  • Have an active part, part B, so the tag can be compared.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the Search box in the top bar is the global search, which lists inventory parts.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Search box in the top bar.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The global search opens.

Step 2:

  • Parts A and B are both listed.
  • Part A carries a grey "Inactive" tag; part B has no tag.
